item.title: OpenAI unveils its first custom chip, built by Broadcom
item.description:
📝 On Wednesday, OpenAI unveiled its first custom-built inference processor, designed and manufactured in collaboration with Broadcom. In the announcement, OpenAI emphasized the chip’s low operating cost when running real-time coding models. OpenAI is already building agentic products like Codex and the models that power them, as well as data centers to run those models.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/24/openai-unveils-its-first-custom-chip-built-by-broadcom/

item.title: I rewrote PostHog's SQL parser, 70x faster, while barely looking at the code
item.description:
📝 Why does PostHog even have an SQL parser. Generating our parser with ANTLRWe didn't write this parser by hand because, at least pre-AI-coding, parsers were extremely difficult to maintain. Instead, we use ANTLR, a state-of-the-art, open source parser generator.
